Olivia (Finance): Flagging Lighthouse Diagnostics on INV-2026-0714-5544. They say a one-time bulk prepaid charge was mistakenly applied twice (prepay token package). Ticket SUP-5128. Customer asking for refund of duplicate prepay + a small promo credit. @Ethan any background on the deal?

Maya (Support): Customer provided payment confirmation showing prepay of $15,000 on 2026-07-01. Their ledger shows two identical prepay line items dated 2026-07-01 and 2026-07-02. Their ticket includes payment refs pay_4442 and pay_4442_dup.

Zoe (Engineering): I checked payments and billing export pipeline: `SELECT payment_ref, amount, created_at FROM payments WHERE payment_ref IN ('pay_4442','pay_4442_dup');`
Results: pay_4442 = 15000, pay_4442_dup = 15000; both cleared in gateway. Looks like the payment webhook retried and duplicate record was created.

Billing Bot: Invoice INV-2026-0714-5544 total $20,340.00. Line items include prepay-package $15,000 twice. Suggested adjustment code ADJ-8672 and potential refund amount $15,000.

Ethan (Sales): Lighthouse is a new enterprise pilot (~$40k ARR expected). Recommend refund full duplicate $15,000 and add a $750 promo credit for platform training sessions. Support the refund and promo to keep them in pilot.

Olivia (Finance): I can approve a $15,000 manual refund under ADJ-8672. For the $750 training credit, finance approves one-time promo. Please include memo: "duplicate prepay refund + training credit" and mark both non-recurring.

Zoe (Engineering): I'll open an adjustment with the gateway refs attached. API call I will run: `POST /internal/billing/adjustments {"invoice":"INV-2026-0714-5544","amount":-15000,"reason":"duplicate prepay refund","code":"ADJ-8672"}`. Will also cancel the duplicate payment record in payments DB and create a remediation ticket for the webhook idempotency.

Maya (Support): Messaging to customer: "We're processing a $15,000 refund for the duplicated prepay and applying a $750 training credit. Refund timeframe 5-7 business days. We'll follow up once ledger posts." Customer replied with thanks and asked for a refund reference to provide to their finance team.

Olivia (Finance): Adding refund reference REF-BNK-2026-0715-LH for the customer's use. Also generating promo code PROMO-LIGHT-750.

Billing Bot: ADJ-8672 queued in billing service and will post after reconciliation. Duplicate payment record pay_4442_dup flagged for reversal.

Ethan (Sales): I'll log the training credit in CRM and coordinate scheduling with Solutions.

Zoe (Engineering): Opening infra bug CH-1224 for webhook idempotency + PR to add dedupe on payment_ref. Attaching logs and payment refs to the adjustment PR.

Billing Bot: ADJ-8672 posted to ledger on 2026-07-16. Invoice INV-2026-0714-5544 updated; PROMO-LIGHT-750 applied. Customer notification sent with refund reference REF-BNK-2026-0715-LH."
